About

We collaborated with Maison Mirabile, a florist in Montmartre, Paris, on its 2024 calendar. Shot with a slow shutter, each bloom slips into colour and light, somewhere between photograph and painting. From image-making to layout and edition, we shaped a printed piece that lets the flowers unfold across the year.
